{"query":"SELECT
  url,
  title,
  published_at,
  query,
  SEM_EXTRACT(
    content,
    page_type := 'type and scope of list or guide',
    coverage := 'Marvel screen productions covered, including formats and date range',

    evidence := 'per_field'
  ) AS details
FROM WEB_SEARCH(
  'Marvel films list all releases 2005 2026 film television specials shorts',
  'Marvel television series list live action animated 2005 present',

  'Marvel legacy movies universes X-Men Fantastic Four Blade Daredevil continuity',

  'Marvel Television series continuity Agents of SHIELD Defenders Inhumans Runaways Cloak Dagger',
  'official Marvel complete MCU timeline Disney Plus 2026'
)
WHERE SEM_MATCH(content, 'is a comprehensive or authoritative source useful for identifying Marvel screen productions released since 2005 or explaining their continuity relationships')
ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST","show_preview":false}

function.name: select
function.arguments:
{"query":"SELECT
  url,
  title,
  SEM_EXTRACT_ALL(
    content,
    'a named film, series, special, short, or screen franchise and an explicit continuity or crossover relationship to another named production or franchise',
    from_title := 'source production, continuity, or franchise name',
    to_title := 'connected production, continuity, or franchise name',
    relationship := 'specific relationship: sequel, prequel, spin-off, shared universe, crossover, reboot, alternate timeline, multiverse crossover, character continuation, or non-canon tie-in',
    explanation := 'concise explanation of how they connect',
    evidence := 'per_field'
  ) AS links
FROM WEB_SEARCH(
  'MCU films television series crossovers continuity guide Marvel',
  'Marvel Television MCU continuity connections Agents SHIELD Agent Carter Daredevil',
  'Defenders Saga MCU canon connection Echo Daredevil Born Again',
  'X-Men film timeline Days Future Past Logan Deadpool continuity explanation',
  'Deadpool Wolverine connection Fox X-Men MCU TVA multiverse',
  'Spider-Man No Way Home connects Raimi Amazing Spider-Man universes',
  'Venom Let There Be Carnage No Way Home MCU post credits connection',
  'The Marvels connects WandaVision Ms Marvel Secret Invasion',
  'Doctor Strange Multiverse Madness connects WandaVision What If X-Men',
  'Marvel animated series shared universe continuity Avengers Assemble Ultimate Spider-Man',
  'Marvel Anime continuity Blade Iron Man Wolverine X-Men crossover',
  'Spider-Verse films continuity Spider-Man 1994 Spectacular animated connections'
)
WHERE SEM_MATCH(content, 'explicitly explains continuity, sequel, spin-off, shared-universe, crossover, reboot, timeline, or multiverse relationships among named Marvel screen productions')","show_preview":false}

function.name: select
function.arguments:
{"query":"SELECT
  SEM_NORM(production_title, 'merge spelling, punctuation, subtitle, and Marvel-prefix variants of the same screen production; keep remakes, reboots, seasons, and distinct films separate') AS production_title,
  MIN(TRY_CAST(release_year AS INTEGER)) AS release_year,
  COALESCE(
    MIN(TRY_CAST(release_date AS DATE)),
    MAKE_DATE(MIN(TRY_CAST(release_year AS INTEGER)), 1, 1)
  ) AS release_or_year_start,
  MODE(format) FILTER (WHERE format IS NOT NULL) AS format,
  MODE(franchise_or_universe) FILTER (WHERE franchise_or_universe IS NOT NULL) AS franchise_or_universe,
  COUNT(DISTINCT url) AS source_count,
  FIRST(url ORDER BY CASE WHEN url LIKE '%wikipedia.org%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, url) AS source_url
FROM (
  SELECT
    url,
    production_title,
    release_date,
    release_year,
    format,
    franchise_or_universe
  FROM (
    SELECT
      url,
      UNNEST(productions, recursive := true)
    FROM r1aedb967554
  )
  WHERE TRY_CAST(release_year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2005 AND 2026

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    url,
    production_title,
    release_date,
    release_year,
    format,
    NULL AS franchise_or_universe
  FROM (
    SELECT
      url,
      UNNEST(productions, recursive := true)
    FROM rc6ae3609934
  )
  WHERE TRY_CAST(release_year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2005 AND 2026
)
WHERE production_title IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY SEM_NORM(production_title, 'merge spelling, punctuation, subtitle, and Marvel-prefix variants of the same screen production; keep remakes, reboots, seasons, and distinct films separate')
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT url) >= 1
ORDER BY release_or_year_start, production_title","show_preview":false}

function.name: select
function.arguments:
{"query":"SELECT
  SEM_NORM(from_title, 'merge spelling and punctuation variants of the same screen production or named continuity') AS from_title,
  SEM_NORM(to_title, 'merge spelling and punctuation variants of the same screen production or named continuity') AS to_title,
  MODE(relationship) FILTER (WHERE relationship IS NOT NULL) AS relationship,
  FIRST(explanation ORDER BY CASE WHEN explanation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS explanation,
  COUNT(DISTINCT url) AS source_count,
  FIRST(url ORDER BY CASE
    WHEN url LIKE '%marvel.com%' OR url LIKE '%disneyplus.com%' THEN 0
    WHEN url LIKE '%wikipedia.org%' THEN 1
    ELSE 2 END, url) AS source_url
FROM (
  SELECT
    url,
    from_title,
    to_title,
    relationship,
    explanation
  FROM (
    SELECT
      url,
      UNNEST(links, recursive := true)
    FROM re930bddb485
  )
  WHERE from_title IS NOT NULL
    AND to_title IS NOT NULL
)
WHERE SEM_MATCH(
  from_title || ' | ' || to_title || ' | ' || COALESCE(relationship, '') || ' | ' || COALESCE(explanation, ''),
  'describes a concrete narrative continuity connection between two Marvel screen productions or screen continuities, not merely similarity, shared creators, marketing, watch-order proximity, speculation, or comics-only connection'
)
GROUP BY
  SEM_NORM(from_title, 'merge spelling and punctuation variants of the same screen production or named continuity'),
  SEM_NORM(to_title, 'merge spelling and punctuation variants of the same screen production or named continuity')
ORDER BY source_count DESC, from_title, to_title","show_preview":false}

    WHEN 'sequel' THEN 4
    WHEN 'prequel' THEN 5
    WHEN 'alternate timeline' THEN 6
    WHEN 'reboot' THEN 7

function.arguments:
{"query":"SELECT
  section,
  continuity_group,
  description,
  connection_to_other_groups,
  caveat,
  source_url
FROM (
  SELECT
    'Continuity architecture' AS section,
    SEM_EXTRACT(content, 'principal Marvel screen continuity, shared universe, franchise timeline, or explicitly separate adaptation continuity') AS continuity_group,
